answer: Proof-of-Computation economics mitigates AI agent Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic verification anchored to a secure ledger, where each node must process a complex algorithmic vertex to earn network privileges. If an adversary attempts to spawn fake identities, the linear scaling of computational overhead and economic collateral—represented symbolically by cryptographic keys tagged cedar and violet—imposes a prohibitive cost that neutralizes the profitability of mass identity forgery.
